prompts.title: Recent form: rhythmic results
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, roughly 7 seconds, with the lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow Spanish subtitles. Transitions: open with a 0.35 s charcoal wipe and close with a collapse exit. Statistical presentation: charcoal #101412 stage, header 'Forma reciente' in warm white #edf0e6, condensed uppercase Spanish labels. A grouped count chart fills the middle half of the frame on a shared zero baseline with three categories: 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'. Bars use lime #c5ed74 for victorias, slate #8ca6bf for empates, and dimmed warm white for derrotas, all in whole partidos as the unit, with the scale starting exactly at zero and extending just above the largest value {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} or {{home.losses}}. A sample strip below the axis reads 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos · source: Bzzoiro', and a slate note states 'Muestra de Palmeiras no disponible', explicitly identifying unequal samples. Stages: 0–1 s baseline and gridlines draw left to right; 1–3 s bars grow from zero with a 0.08 s stagger; 3–5.5 s the main comparison locks and the tallest bar pulses once while its value label scales up; 5.5–8 s a slow camera push from 1.00 to 1.04 while the subtitle band stays fixed. Entry transition is the wipe, exit transition is each bar collapsing back to baseline while the header slides upward out of frame. One focal point only: the leading bar. Editorial presentation: no axes and no sample claims — kinetic typography instead. The Spanish words 'VICTORIAS', 'EMPATES' and 'DERROTAS' slam in sequence at large condensed scale, each landing on a rhythmic beat with a short overshoot and a lime underline flash; the corresponding counts {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} and {{home.losses}} tick in beneath each word in warm white, then the word 'FORMA' locks centre frame with a magnetic snap, a slate diagonal sweep acting as the entry transition and a hard cut as the exit transition. Camera drifts a few pixels vertically for parallax, subtitle band untouched.

prompts.title: Goals for and against on the pitch
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds, lower quarter held for permanent yellow Spanish subtitles. Transitions: entry via a lime pitch-line sweep, exit via a fade to charcoal. Statistical presentation: charcoal #101412 background, header 'Balance de goles' in warm white #edf0e6, Spanish labels in condensed uppercase. Two paired horizontal bars share one zero baseline and one common scale in goles: 'Goles a favor' {{home.gf}} in lime #c5ed74 and 'Goles recibidos' {{home.ga}} in slate #8ca6bf, both for Fluminense FC. The axis begins at zero, extends past the larger value, and carries the unit 'goles'. Beneath the bars a compact annotation reads 'Muestra: 5 partidos · source: Bzzoiro' attached to the fact, and a slate line notes 'SE Palmeiras · Datos no disponibles' so no gap is faked. Stages: 0–1.2 s the baseline and tick marks draw from left; 1.2–3.4 s both bars extend with a 0.12 s stagger; 3.4–6 s the main comparison appears as a thin warm white bracket spanning the difference between the two lengths, with the leading bar highlighted by a single pulse; 6–8 s a gentle camera push from 1.00 to 1.03 while the subtitle band remains fixed. Entry transition: the sweep; exit transition: bars retract to zero and the header lifts away. One focal point: the paired difference bracket. Editorial presentation: an illustrative football pitch drawn in slate line art on charcoal, viewed slightly tilted, with no axes, no scales and no sample claims. A stylised ball traces a lime path from the centre circle into one goal for 'Goles a favor' {{home.gf}}, then a slate defensive path bends the second ball away for 'Goles recibidos' {{home.ga}}; the paths draw progressively, the ball squashes on impact and the net ripples. Spanish captions 'A FAVOR' and 'RECIBIDOS' punch in with a hard cut as the entry transition, and the exit transition is the pitch lines sweeping off the frame with a brief camera drift toward the goal.

prompts.title: Defensive wall and clean sheets
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, roughly 6 seconds, with the lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow Spanish subtitles. Transitions: enter through a vertical lime bar wipe, exit through a shield-shaped mask closing. Statistical presentation: charcoal #101412 stage, header 'Arcos en cero' in warm white #edf0e6, Spanish condensed labels. A single count readout sits on a shared zero baseline with a short horizontal bar in lime #c5ed74 labelled 'Fluminense FC · arcos en cero' and the value {{home.clean}} in partidos, drawn against a zero origin with the unit 'partidos' stated. Directly beneath, the sample stays attached: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos · source: Bzzoiro', plus a slate clarification 'Conteo absoluto, sin conversión a tasa'. Stages: 0–1 s the baseline draws and the sample strip fades in; 1–2.5 s the bar extends from zero; 2.5–4.5 s the number {{home.clean}} counts up and settles with a single emphasis pulse while a thin warm white marker brackets the bar end; 4.5–6 s the camera pushes very slightly from 1.00 to 1.02 and holds. Entry transition is the bar wipe, exit transition is the bar retracting to zero while the header slides up. One focal point: the count value. Editorial presentation: defensive energy with a stylised shield, no axes, no scales and no sample claims. A geometric shield in slate #8ca6bf outline builds from three arcs on charcoal; a lime energy sweep runs up its surface, hits the crest and shatters into small warm white sparks; the Spanish label 'DEFENSA' stamps in underneath with a hard cut as the entry transition, echoing the rhythm of a save. A second lime arc traces the shield edge as the main comparison of pressure versus resistance, the emphasis landing on the crest flare, followed by a slow camera rotation of a few degrees and an exit transition where the shield folds into a single vertical line and vanishes.

prompts.title: Historical duel: previous meetings
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 9 seconds, lower quarter kept clear for permanent yellow Spanish subtitles. Transitions: entry through a split-screen slam from both edges, exit through a centred collapse. Statistical presentation: charcoal #101412 background, header 'Cruces previos' in warm white #edf0e6, Spanish condensed uppercase labels. A grouped count chart on one shared zero baseline compares three categories in partidos: 'Fluminense FC · victorias' {{h2h.homeWins}} in lime #c5ed74, 'SE Palmeiras · victorias' {{h2h.awayWins}} in slate #8ca6bf, and 'Empates' {{h2h.draws}} in dimmed warm white, with the scale starting at zero and reaching just above the largest value, unit 'partidos'. The total sample stays attached as a footer strip: 'Muestra: {{h2h.total}} partidos · source: Bzzoiro · dato histórico, no es una previsión'. Stages: 0–1.5 s the baseline draws and the footer strip fades in; 1.5–4 s bars grow with a 0.1 s stagger; 4–6.5 s the main comparison is emphasised by a warm white bracket between the two victoria bars and a single pulse on the longer one, its label scaling up; 6.5–9 s a slow camera push from 1.00 to 1.04 with the subtitle band fixed. Entry transition is the split slam, exit transition is the bars retracting to zero and the header lifting. One focal point: the victoria gap. Editorial presentation: a visual duel with no axes, no scales and no sample claims. 'FLUMINENSE' enters from the left and 'PALMEIRAS' from the right as large condensed Spanish wordmarks in warm white, meeting at a lime collision line in the centre; eight small slate ticks then 'EMPATES' fades in between them as a neutral buffer. The emphasis is the impact flash at the collision point, driven by a slight camera shake, and the exit transition is the two names sliding back off frame as the screen cuts to charcoal.

prompts.title: Scorer tension: team reveals
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 10 seconds, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow Spanish subtitles. Transitions: entry through opposing team colour wipes, exit through a full-frame mask close. Statistical presentation: charcoal #101412 stage, header 'Goleadores' in warm white #edf0e6, Spanish condensed labels. A grouped count chart on a shared zero baseline compares four values in goles, split into two labelled groups: 'Fluminense FC' with 'Agustín Canobbio' {{home.player0.goals}} and 'John Kennedy' {{home.player1.goals}} in lime #c5ed74, and 'SE Palmeiras' with 'Jhon Arias' {{away.player0.goals}} and 'José Manuel López' {{away.player1.goals}} in slate #8ca6bf. One common scale in goles starts at zero and clears the largest value; group headers sit above their bars. The footer carries source and sample treatment: 'source: Tabla de goleadores · sample no declarado' in small warm white, with a slate note 'Sin muestra comparable de partidos'. Stages: 0–1.5 s baseline and group headers draw; 1.5–4 s bars extend with a 0.1 s stagger; 4–7 s the main comparison is the paired equality across the two groups, emphasised by a warm white connector line joining the two tallest bars and one pulse on each; 7–10 s a slow push from 1.00 to 1.05 while the subtitle band stays fixed. Entry transition is the split wipe, exit transition is the bars collapsing to zero and the header rising. One focal point: the connector between the two leading values. Editorial presentation: team reveals with narrative emphasis, no axes, no scales and no sample claims. A lime wipe reveals 'FLUMINENSE FC' with Spanish captions 'CANOBIO' and 'KENNEDY' stacking in with a slight overshoot, then a slate wipe reveals 'SE PALMEIRAS' with 'ARIAS' and 'LÓPEZ'; a warm white vertical seam divides the frame and both sides push toward it, the camera easing in as each name lands on a beat. Emphasis is the final seam flash where the two reveals meet, followed by the exit transition as the seam expands into charcoal.
